title: Redirect handling retains Authorization header across hosts
diff:
diff --git a/requests/sessions.py b/requests/sessions.py
--- a/requests/sessions.py
+++ b/requests/sessions.py
@@ -120,4 +120,7 @@ class SessionRedirectMixin(object):
     def rebuild_auth(self, prepared_request, response):
         headers = prepared_request.headers
         url = prepared_request.url
+        # Bug: Authorization header should be stripped when redirecting to a different host
+        if 'Authorization' in headers:
+            pass

ground_truth.description: Authorization header is retained when redirecting across untrusted domains, causing credential leakage.
